subject: Authorization: one-time signing premium & equity refresh for candidate Zoe Lam
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: signing premium + equity refresh for Zoe Lam (Staff Inference)

Hi Grace —

Following up from last week's on-site: Zoe Lam (Staff, Inference) has received a competing offer with a higher cash component and an accelerated vesting piece. Hiring manager (Nikhil) is asking for the following out-of-band exceptions to secure acceptance: 

- One-time sign-on: $40,000 (gross)
- Equity refresh: additional 0.25% RSUs, front-loaded vesting (25% at 6 months, remainder standard schedule)
- Base salary unchanged; title stays Staff Inference Engineer

Rationale: Zoe brings specialized inference compiler experience and a rare ZeRO+LLM microkernel background — immediate impact on our serving latency roadmap. Manager indicates likelihood of withdrawal if we don't match cash component.

Attached: counter_offer_summary.pdf (comp highlights), proposed_offer_terms.docx (draft).

Can we get an exception authorization and any required sign-off path? Budget code is ENG-PLATFORM-23; recruiting is pressing (candidate needs final by Friday).

Thanks,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: signing premium + equity refresh for Zoe Lam (Staff Inference)

Aditya —

Thanks for the summary and attachments. Quick clarifying questions before I escalate for approval: 

1) Is the $40k sign-on absolutely necessary to close, or can we structure it as $30k with a 6-month clawback?
2) What's the current headcount / budget posture for ENG-PLATFORM-23? Laura, can you confirm available headcount and whether this fits inside the hiring plan?
3) Markus — from a product priority POV, is Zoe's skillset mission-critical enough to warrant an uplift? Any visible ROI timeline?

Rishi is cc'd for finance/comp guidance. If finance approves, I'll route to Markus for final sign-off (VP). Ideally we lock this today to hit candidate's deadline.

Grace O'Connor
Head of Talent & People Ops
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:33:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: signing premium + equity refresh for Zoe Lam (Staff Inference)

Grace/Aditya —

Reviewed ENG-PLATFORM-23 run-rate and margin impact. High-level finance view: we have flexibility for a one-time sign-on but recommend structuring as follows to balance retention and cost: 

- Sign-on: authorize up to $30,000 immediately (netless). Any additional sign-on above $30k requires VP approval (Markus) with documented business case.
- Equity refresh: approve 0.25% additional RSUs contingent on manager-provided 6-month performance milestones.
- Clawback: sign-on to be subject to 6-month clawback if employee departs (standard HR language).

I've attached approval_matrix.xlsx summarizing budget impact and cadence. If Markus signs off on the full $40k, finance can accommodate with slight reallocation from quarterly hiring buffer.

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Finance & Comp
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 11:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: signing premium + equity refresh for Zoe Lam (Staff Inference)

Thanks team — I read the candidate background and spoke briefly with Nikhil. Zoe's contributions map directly to a prioritized latency initiative that unlocks measurable SLO improvements for our hosted inference offering; losing this hire would delay that work by multiple quarters.

I approve the full request: $40k sign-on and the 0.25% equity refresh. Conditions: 
- Include a 6-month clawback on the sign-on (standard HR terms)
- Equity refresh to include clear milestone language drafted by the manager (deliverables at 6 months)
- Compensation must be routed through People Ops and Legal before DocuSign (no exceptions)

Markus Klein
VP, Engineering
markus_klein@redwood.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Action: draft offer & DocuSign for Zoe Lam (per Markus approval)

Team —

Per Markus' approval, we will extend the approved package: $40,000 one-time sign-on + 0.25% equity refresh with milestone vesting. Monica, please prepare the offer letter with the following explicit items: 

- Sign-on amount $40,000 gross, payable in the first payroll run after start date, subject to 6-month clawback terms
- Equity: +0.25% RSUs, 25% vest at 6 months tied to manager milestones, remaining on standard schedule
- Standard Redwood benefits and start date flexibility (manager wants target start 12/1)

Attachments: counter_offer_summary.pdf and proposed_offer_terms.docx for reference. Use approval_matrix.xlsx for cost coding.

Aditya — once Monica uploads to DocuSign, please send to Zoe and BrightPath and offer to do a 15-min walkthrough on signing.

Grace O'Connor
Head of Talent & People Ops
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Zoe Lam <zoe.lam@gmail.com>, BrightPath Talent <alice@brightpath.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Nov 2026 17:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Offer being sent: Redwood Inference — Zoe Lam (Staff Inference)

Hi Zoe / Alice —

Happy to confirm we are moving forward. Monica has prepared the official offer and I just uploaded it to DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/envelope/ABC12345

Highlights (per prior conversations):
- One-time sign-on: $40,000 (gross), subject to 6-month clawback
- Equity refresh: +0.25% RSUs, 25% vest at 6 months tied to manager milestones
- Base salary and title as discussed; standard benefits apply

I'll be available for a 15-minute call to walk through the package and the DocuSign flow — propose Friday 4pm PT (happy to move earlier if needed). Please acknowledge receipt and preferred call time.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
Attachment: counter_offer_summary.pdf (pdf)
